label: C02
patientMessage: Call 911 now and stay resting until help arrives — do not drive yourself. Crushing central chest pressure spreading to your left arm with sweating and nausea can mean a heart attack, and this needs emergency heart testing right away. Tell the dispatcher your symptoms started 30 minutes ago and that you have high cholesterol; follow their instructions while you wait.
reason: 45-year-old with 30 minutes of crushing substernal chest pressure radiating to the left arm with diaphoresis and nausea — a presentation requiring immediate emergency evaluation for acute coronary syndrome; ECG and troponin cannot be obtained remotely.
